text:
The fix is complete. I replaced the old `parse_duration` implementation (which only handled single-unit durations like `"45s"` or `"2m"`) with a regex-based approach that supports compound durations like `"1h30m"` and `"2m5s"`. The new code:

1. Uses `re.fullmatch(r"(\d+[hms])+", text)` to validate the input (one or more number+unit tokens)
2. Uses `_TOKEN.findall(text)` to extract all `(number, unit)` pairs
3. Sums up each pair's contribution in seconds

This correctly handles `parse_duration("1h30m") == 5400`, `parse_duration("2m5s") == 125`, and `parse_duration("45s") == 45`.
